text.en: It doesn't matter which side of a concrete beam the reinforcing steel is placed on, as long as the right amount of steel is embedded somewhere in the concrete -- in reality, reinforcement only resists the tension a bending member actually develops if it is placed on the tension side of that member; rebar placed on the compression side instead does essentially nothing to prevent the tensile cracking/failure the member is actually vulnerable to.
text.et: Pole vahet, kummale poole betoontala teraskarkass paigutatakse, kuni õige kogus terast on kuskil betooni sisse valatud -- tegelikult vastab sarrus paindeelemendi tegelikult arendatavale tõmbele ainult siis, kui see paigutatakse selle elemendi tõmbepoolele; survepoolele paigutatud sarrus ei anna sisuliselt midagi elemendi tegeliku haavatavuse -- tõmbepragunemise/purunemise -- vältimiseks.
